notes.title: Celebrating 10 Years of CasinoRPG
notes.content:
Wow! Can you believe it? CasinoRPG is turning 10 on April 16, 2024! What started as a dream project back in 2012 has turned into a decade-long adventure of building, betting and bonding. A huge shoutout to our Kickstarter backers for helping to get us off the ground in early 2013 and to all of you for joining the game -- whether you’ve been here since the early beta days or just joined the party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31719929/623ad7bf6cbcad6067dd05be001710302663fa43.jpg[/img]
However, the full release in 2014 was only the beginning of the story. From our early days to now, CasinoRPG has grown immensely, thanks in large part to all of your ideas and feedback. It’s been a blast adding new features, gameplay, events and various updates over the years. We've been even more thrilled to see how this community has grown into one of the best places to hang out with new and old friends online! Seriously, you all make CasinoRPG what it is, and we’re excited to keep building this world into what you all want it to be.

Whether you’ve been building your casino empire from day one or you’re just starting your own journey, we appreciate each and every one of you. Every suggestion, every bug report and every high-five has helped shape CasinoRPG. We're just as excited today as we were in 2014 for what’s ahead, and we’ve got an ever-growing list of ideas to continue evolving the game into the future. So, here’s to the next chapter in our CasinoRPG adventure -- may it be filled with luck, laughter and many new friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31719929/a72ad7126e994df22ef0c592b1ea25f39b08239c.jpg[/img]

With the Summer Olympics getting under way, we have a set of 6 new limited edition Summer Olympics-themed items! Get the details on how you can get yours before they are gone for good after August 7 by clicking on the Olympic rings icon at the top of the game screen.

GoldFire City is playing host to the Summer Olympics! Can you take home the gold? Click on the medal icon next to the Olympic rings to see the progress and get details on how to participate in this community-wide event. Participants that reach their goal and the community goal will receive a new limited edition Olympics Medal Race Trophy item!

[b]FEATURE[/b] Starting in August, a new formula will be used to calculate Overall Monthly Rankings. The new formula is intended to be a better all-around measurement and no longer factors chip gains/losses into the score (but it does factor in a variety of other metrics).
[b]UPDATE[/b] Dragging an already-placed item on a floor/lot no longer requires an extra click on the accept button.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Searching the Real Estate Market by address is now supported.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Non-citizens now have a "walk to" or "find taxi" button in place of the "driver" button on the mini-map.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Background music now gets faded out while playing slots.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The Environment details window now has a help button like the other editor stats.
[b]FIX[/b] The editor could sometimes allow placing an item in an illegal position, which the server would correctly reject and then it would appear as if your change had been reverted when next visiting the floor. The editor now does a better job of catching this before it reaches the server.
[b]FIX[/b] The editor panel could sometimes get detached from the bottom of the screen.
[b]FIX[/b] Clicking in the few pixels between the two doors on the first floor of a casino now registers as leaving the casino.
[b]FIX[/b] The item upgrade modal now correctly checks if you can afford an upgrade before letting you apply it.
[b]FIX[/b] Issues when displaying multiple pages of live battles.
[b]FIX[/b] The Bartender job mini-game has been further tweaked to fix difficulty issues.
[b]FIX[/b] Video Poker winnings now display for a more reasonable amount of time.
[b]FIX[/b] Searching for "Nameless Gambling Den" now works like any other casino name.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other quality-of-life fixes and improvements.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: v1.6.24
notes.content:
[b]FEATURE[/b] Added 21 new hotel items in the wellness amenity category.
[b]UPDATE[/b] All numeric inputs (auction house, casino market, casino points market, etc) now show comma separators to make it more clear what you are entering.
[b]UPDATE[/b] New community event trophies for solitaire and roulette will now be available moving forward.
[b]FIX[/b] Keyboard movement would sometimes randomly stop working for some keys.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other adjustments and fixes to keyboard movement.
[b]FIX[/b] Various fixes with party bomb items due to the prior performance improvements.
[b]FIX[/b] Sorting wasn't consistent on each page of the foreclosure auctions, which caused some to appear to go missing.
[b]FIX[/b] A similar sorting issue was present in the Casino Points market.
[b]FIX[/b] Taking the taxi to some buildings would take you to the back of the building.
[b]FIX[/b] Casino games, ATMs, etc would sometimes stop being functional after selling items from the editor.
[b]FIX[/b] Error at end of war prevented some players from getting their trophy.
[b]FIX[/b] Some casinos that didn't sell at auction would get stuck in the placeholder account.
[b]FIX[/b] Daily scratcher limits now reset at midnight with everything else, regardless of daylight savings.
[b]FIX[/b] The games menu is now hidden until after your daily spin on mobile to prevent conflicts.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other bug fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: v1.6.3
notes.content:
[b]FEATURE[/b] You can now move your character using WASD or arrow keys rather than just the mouse (the local chat shortcut has been changed to "X" from "S" to accommodate).
[b]UPDATE[/b] The daily reset now happens at midnight game time, regardless of daylight savings.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Improved performance of crowded party bomb floors by 30-40% (the sorting of items on some floors may have changed, but no items are missing).
[b]UPDATE[/b] Increased per-floor party bomb item limit from 10k to 15k due to performance improvements.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Improved syncing of party bomb items on crowded floors to better guarantee that everyone is seeing the same items.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Increased the stats on the Poker God Trophy that is awarded at level 100.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Condo and sprint invites are now blocked when you ignore a player.
[b]UPDATE[/b] New crew members default to having their battle status off (so they must be aware of being eligible for battle before getting included in one).
[b]UPDATE[/b] Various improvements to the new player tutorials.
[b]FIX[/b] Using a taxi to travel to casinos saved in your favorites wouldn't always drop you off at quite the right location.
[b]FIX[/b] A daily free spin could be overwritten when collecting a free spin from a party bomb at the daily reset.
[b]FIX[/b] The "watch list" button now shows on empty lots too.
[b]FIX[/b] It was possible for a crew battle match to happen shortly after the 24-hour window.

notes.title: Easter Promo/Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31719929/e64e5c85878cfaef884a0d676109d34e5396359c.jpg[/img]

GoldFire City is fully decorated for the season and we have 6 exciting limited edition items! Get the details on how you can get yours before they are gone for good after April 14 by clicking on the egg icon at the top of the game screen.

It wouldn't be Easter without a massive Easter Egg Hunt! Click on the basket icon next to the promo icon to see the progress and get details on how to participate in this community-wide contest. Participants that reach their goal and the community goal will receive a limited edition Egg Hunt 2021 Trophy item!

[b]UPDATE[/b] Added a real estate market "watch list" button to casinos on the mini-map.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Added an "empty lot" filter to the real estate market.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Added a "my watch list" filter to the real estate market.
[b]UPDATE[/b] When declining a condo invite, that person won't be able to send you another for an hour.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Prevent removing items from the floor/lot of a casino that is listed for sale.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Added daily reset popup to make it more clear when the new in-game day has started.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Added an upper limit of 10,000 party bomb items to a floor to prevent excessive lag issues caused by loading so much data at once.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The poker battle/war challenge now has a minimum of 3 players instead of 4 to match the minimum team size.
[b]FIX[/b] If a foreclosure lot/casino didn't sell the first time, it would incorrectly wait 6 months to be listed again instead of a few weeks.
[b]FIX[/b] Camera pan position on casino floors is no longer reset after exiting a free daily spin from a party bomb.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: Announcing the Next Game from GoldFire Studios!
notes.content:
While CasinoRPG continues to get frequent updates (and we have so much more in store for the game!), we also like to keep our creative juices flowing by working on other projects. Our latest is a significant departure, and we're excited to finally make it public!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275550/Arctic_Awakening/]Arctic Awakening[/url] is an episodic narrative adventure set in the unforgiving Arctic. Your plane crashed in a storm, leaving only your AI drone for company as you journey to find your co-pilot and uncover the dark mysteries buried beneath the ice.

This is a first-person, single player game in full 3D that will be released on PC, Mac and game consoles in 2022. Check out the reveal trailer below and be sure to add to your Steam wishlist:

notes.content:
[b]FEATURE[/b] Added 17 new hotel entertainment amenity items (new seating, magic acts, new lighting, etc).
[b]UPDATE[/b] Overhauled the system that connects the client to the server to improve speed and stability, especially with lots of players in the same location.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Using the driver to go to one of your casinos now works again from an upper floor (and should avoid the issues it used to have).
[b]FIX[/b] The hotel manager would sometimes say the wrong thing based on your occupancy rate.
[b]FIX[/b] The numbering of the casino leaderboard on mobile was off.
[b]FIX[/b] Blackjack wasn't paying out the correct CP in some instances.
[b]FIX[/b] Toggling Dealer Chat in poker chat would sometimes cause player chat to not be visible.

notes.title: Mardi Gras Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31719929/1f2cd79dbd5183dc6be4a35b4c552f08fafcd6a0.jpg[/img]

The city is decked out for the Mardi Gras festivities, and we have 6 exciting limited edition items available! Get the details on how you can get yours before they are gone for good after February 24 by clicking on the Mardi Gras hat icon at the top of the game screen.

Join up with the rest of the community and collect the most Mardi Gras beads from the casinos of GoldFire City! Click the beads icon next to the promo icon to see the progress and get details on how to participate in this community-wide contest. Participants that reach their goal and the community goal will receive a new limited edition trophy item!

[b]FEATURE[/b] There is a new filter in the Auction House that lets you view any active auctions that you have bid on (even if you aren't currently the high bidder).
[b]FEATURE[/b] The Real Estate Market has also been updated with a search bar and filters for star-rating and whether or not you've bid on an auction (again, regardless of if you are the current high bidder).
[b]FEATURE[/b] Elevators in your own casinos now show a VIP Disabled/Enabled indicator to make it even more clear when VIP is enabled or disabled on your floors.
[b]UPDATE[/b] If someone invites you to join a sprint mission and you decline, they'll be blocked from inviting you again for an hour.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Submitted v1.3.0 of the mobile app for review with App Store and Google Play (fixes and performance improvements).
[b]UPDATE[/b] NPCs will no longer block you from playing at a specific slot machine (though they still won't be happy about giving it up!).
[b]UPDATE[/b] More adjustments to further cap the difficulty in the janitor and bartender job mini-games.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Deleted messages in global chat are now simply removed instead of being changed to placeholder deleted text.
[b]FIX[/b] Various optimizations to the simulation server to prevent it from getting backed up and causing some casinos to be stuck on "updating" for long periods of time.
[b]FIX[/b] If you had an hour or longer 2XP flag and received a shorter one from slots, the flag would disappear before your 2XP actually expired.
[b]FIX[/b] Some casinos bought from the auctions would show as opened from the inside but wouldn't allow anyone else to enter from the outside.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: New Slot - King's Ransom
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31719929/5e7ebaaff7021f3b517b1eaf115c4be19bd9c7da.jpg[/img]

An all new slot game, King's Ransom, is now available! It can be accessed from the slot lobby or the games menu in your in-game phone (as well as visiting a casino that already has the new game). To go along with the new slot game, there are 34 new medieval-themed items available for your casinos (slot machines, decorations, wall items, furniture, dividers, etc).

Other changes in this update include:

[b]FEATURE[/b] A leaderboard showing the top 250 casinos by hourly profit can be accessed from the Hourly Profit details window in the Editor of any of your casinos.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Previously, casinos owned by inactive accounts that had run out of chips to cover losses would just be demolished and bypass the auctions. Now, they'll go straight to auction instead (so that all inactive casinos will eventually go to auction).
[b]UPDATE[/b] Separated the "exclusive" filter in the Auction House to "exclusive" and "limited." Exclusive is for unbreakable promo items/trophies and limited is for items exclusively from Party Bombs.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The purchase/bid popups in the Real Estate Market now show the CP fee next to the purchase/bid price so it is more obvious (the full chip/casino point fee can still be seen by hovering/clicking on the info icon to the right of the amount).
[b]FIX[/b] Various issues with the Auction House sorting when going between tabs.
[b]FIX[/b] The text "Pair" has been changed to "Jacks or Better" in Video Poker.
[b]FIX[/b] Leveling up twice at once could cause a duplicated popup to get stuck.
[b]FIX[/b] More fixes and improvements to the new player tutorial.
[b]FIX[/b] Janitor shifts should no longer be able to send you to a hotel floor.

notes.title: Holiday Event/Promo
notes.content:
[b]HOLIDAY PROMO:[/b] The city is decked out for the holiday season and we have 6 exciting limited edition items available! Get the details on how you can get yours before they are gone for good after January 6 by clicking on the snowflake icon at the top of the game screen.

[b]UNBEARD THE SHARK 2020:[/b] The city is in need of everyone's help solving a mystery that could ruin this most joyous time of year! Click on the Santa Hat icon next to the promo icon to see the progress and get details on how to participate in this community-wide contest. Participants that reach their goal and the community goal will receive a new limited edition Unbeard the Shark Trophy item!

[b]FEATURE[/b] Added a "pin" icon to the Casinos App in your in-game phone. This lets you pin any of your properties to the start of the list.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The Auction House now has two filters that can be used at the same time: single/multi and exclusive/non-exclusive.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The history tab in the Auction House now has the same search and filter options as the main listings.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The "Exclusive" and "Non-Exclusive" filters in the Auction House now work the same as in the Vault.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Adjusted down the max bartender job mini-game difficulty.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The number of CP symbols animating to your total in slots now matches the number awarded from each symbol (based on a random multiplier that can be applied by betting closer to your max bet).
[b]UPDATE[/b] You can now only join or start a Solitaire Sprint if you don't already have an active game of solitaire in progress.
[b]FIX[/b] Searching for hotel items now works correctly in the Auction House.
[b]FIX[/b] Live updating of auction price/bids is now working again.
[b]FIX[/b] Deleted messages from one chat channel would sometimes show up in another.
[b]FIX[/b] Some sprint mission invite windows would get blocked due to another invite window already being open.
[b]FIX[/b] The chart for the guest ratings could sometimes show the values off by 1 due to a rounding error.
[b]FIX[/b] Clicking "Vault All Items" multiple times would appear to add them multiple times to your vault (just a client-side visual glitch).
[b]FIX[/b] Issues with adding multiple hotel floors at once.
[b]FIX[/b] Various issues with the new player tutorial.

notes.title: Summer Event & Update
notes.content:
We have 6 new limited edition summer-themed items available for your casinos! Get the details on how you can get yours before they are gone for good after August 6 by clicking on the beach ball icon at the top of the game screen.

It wouldn't be summer without over-eating from the grill! Click on the hot dog icon next to the promo icon to see the progress and get details on how to participate in this community-wide hot dog eating contest. Participants that reach their goal and the community goal will receive a limited edition Hot Dog Eating Trophy item!

[b]FEATURE[/b] Similar to the trade chat channel we recently added, there is now an "events" chat channel for things like CA events, wars, poker leagues, etc. There is also a setting to hide this from your quick chat.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Adjusted the rendering of the iOS and Android apps to lower battery usage, in some cases by as much as 2x.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The name and description of each mission giver is now displayed when clicking on them on the mini-map.
[b]UPDATE[/b] To get poker more in-line with all of the other casino games, there are now level limits applied to the tables you can join based on the stakes of the table.
[b]UPDATE[/b] A chat message deleted by a CA versus a user is now made clear.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Added a setting to select behavior when exiting a free daily spin collected from a party bomb.
[b]UPDATE[/b] There is now an info button on the ATM menu giving more information about how Party Bombs work.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The "GET CA" button in chat is now "HELP" and gives information about getting both community and technical support.
[b]FIX[/b] After completing a slot tournament, the phone app windows could sometimes get stuck on the screen at half opacity.
[b]FIX[/b] It was possible to get stuck on a black screen after joining a slot tournament.
[b]FIX[/b] Slot tournament countdown time is now synced to server time to help keep everyone on the same countdown.
[b]FIX[/b] Moving an elevator now works correctly on hotel floors.
[b]FIX[/b] A variety of issues that could cause changes to a floor to not persist.
[b]FIX[/b] Various issues with getting stuck during bingo games.
[b]FIX[/b] Bingo wasn't correctly showing the doubled XP on the client (it was being awarded correctly on the server).
[b]FIX[/b] Crew upgrade purchases wouldn't always go to the right thing on mobile.
[b]FIX[/b] A duplicated notice would be sent when visiting a hotel floor.
[b]FIX[/b] A variety of server errors that could cause all sorts of different random bugs, including disconnects.

notes.title: Father's Day Event/Promo
notes.content:
[b]FATHER'S DAY EVENT:[/b] Father's Day is almost here, so we've started a fun community challenge running through Sunday, June 21! If the community goal is met and you also achieve your personal goal, then you will receive a special new Father's Day trophy item. Click on the icon at the top of the game screen for details and progress.
[b]FATHER'S DAY PROMO:[/b] To cap off the above event, we'll also be running a special one-day promo on a super limited edition Father's Day item on Sunday!

[b]FEATURE[/b] There are 16 new hotel items in the amenity category "restaurant."
[b]UPDATE[/b] Open hotels now give a boost to your vault capacity. Each open hotel adds +25% to the base vault capacity (each open casino already adds +100% to the base capacity).
[b]UPDATE[/b] Announcements in global chat are now shown on a single line with the ability to page through them so that they don't cover up so much of the chat.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The colors for casino metrics now match everywhere to make it easier to identify them (casinos app, editor, real estate market).
[b]UPDATE[/b] The cap on XP increasing per level has been raised for most missions.
[b]UPDATE[/b] When selling all filtered items at one time from your vault, a warning will now be displayed if that contains any limited edition items.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Wars will now alternate between starting at 8AM and 8PM game time instead of being at semi-random times.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Anyone can now delete their own global/trade/crew chat messages.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Announcements in crew chat can now only be removed by a crew leader or the person who posted it.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked the spacing of video poker cards to be more in line with common video poker games.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Various fixes and improvements to the new player tutorial.
[b]FIX[/b] It was possible to get stuck with an infinite loading indicator in solitaire through various scenarios, but especially after winning a hand.
[b]FIX[/b] Party Bomb pickups wouldn't continue collecting automatically after exiting a daily slot spin.
[b]FIX[/b] If you leveled up twice at one time, the 2nd level up display would get stuck on the screen.
[b]FIX[/b] Improved some scenarios where many bombs on a floor could get slightly out of sync across clients.
[b]FIX[/b] Some of the jackpots on the scratchers weren't showing the list of winners correctly.
[b]FIX[/b] The "disable ignore in global" option didn't always work correctly.
[b]FIX[/b] When building a new crew hall, the building will now correctly be closed if the "private hall" setting is selected.

notes.title: v1.6.11

notes.title: v1.6.0 - Hotels!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31719929/ffe3485938fee726af079f07c9d4ca0671817462.jpg[/img]

[b]FEATURE[/b] You can now add a hotel business to your casinos using the new "Hotels" tab in the casino editor! A casino must be 2-star or greater and you can build as many hotel floors as you have casino floors. The hotels tab offers some new metrics (keep in mind that just like in the casino, changes you make take time to fully reflect) as well as the ability to set room rates for the various types of rooms your hotel offers.
[b]FEATURE[/b] When editing your hotel floors, you'll find a new "Amenities" item category, which boasts 129 new items spanning 3 different hotel amenity types: entertainment, restaurant and wellness. Any non-game item can be placed on a hotel floor and amenity items can only be placed on hotel floors. Many of these new amenity items can be interacted with like bars.
[b]FEATURE[/b] Three new job types have been added: housekeeper, wellness worker and waiter.
[b]FEATURE[/b] The hotel buildings out in the world can finally be entered! Once inside, you are greeted with a fancy hotel lobby, and speaking to the concierge allows you to visit a random hotel floor somewhere in the city.
[b]FEATURE[/b] The elevator now has a casino/hotel toggle that lets you go to either the casino or hotel floors.
[b]FEATURE[/b] The elevator also shows the game and amenity types available on each floor with icons under the floor names.
[b]FEATURE[/b] The casino profit window has been updated to show the breakdown of casino and hotel revenue.
[b]FEATURE[/b] The casinos app has been updated to show which of your casinos have hotels and shows the individual floors for each.
[b]FEATURE[/b] NPC's have been updated to visit the hotels, use the amenities and say new phrases.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Card shuffling in all our card games use a standard shuffling algorithm that many card games use, but we've taken it a step further by adding 7 "riffle" shuffles in addition to the standard shuffle to better simulate real-life shuffling.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Further tweaked down item break frequency on upgraded items.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Only players with verified accounts can send condo invites now.
[b]FIX[/b] The final order of slot sprints and tournaments didn't always show correctly when the winner was declared.

notes.title: Easter Egg Hunt
notes.content:

Lots of new updates and fixes are included as well:

[b]FEATURE[/b] Lots without a casino can now be clicked on in the mini-map to see their name, address and who owns them.
[b]FEATURE[/b] The mobile apps for iOS and Android now support pinch-to-zoom so that you can zoom in to see details and zoom out to better see the world or the casino floors. This works on phones and tablets.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Made significant improvements to the rendering of the game to improve overall performance, especially on mobile (which should help with battery usage). We are seeing increases anywhere from 15-50% depending on the device being used.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Floors with VIP status disabled can now be moved to the first floor of a casino (VIP will remain disabled until they are no longer on the first floor).
[b]UPDATE[/b] Improved the consistency of XP award animations with double-XP to make it more clear (you always were awarded correctly, but sometimes it was confusing).
[b]UPDATE[/b] Profiles now show the name of lots that don't have a casino on them.
[b]UPDATE[/b] When on a chat ban, you are also blocked from buying table items for others.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Clicking to edit a lot from the phone while inside a building now walks your character outside before going to the lot editor instead of just giving an error.
[b]UPDATE[/b] There is now a confirmation popup when listing CP for sale.
[b]UPDATE[/b] When building a new casino, there is now an instant build option sort of like when buying items for your casino. This is only for a new casino and not upgrades.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked down the size of the mini-map on phones so that it didn't cover up so much of the screen.

notes.title: v1.5.0
notes.content:
While we have updates often, this one is particularly noteworthy because of how much of the game it touches. We've got updates to crew wars, navigation, the real estate office, intro tutorials and lots more!

[b]FEATURE[/b] We've been collecting all of your feedback on the crew wars and have created a new war experience that is a lot more fun and a lot more fair! The new system does away with teams (which means nobody has to be on the bench) in favor of an "all out war" system. The points/chips buy-in is now awarded at the end to the top 10% of individual players, similar to how payouts in a poker tournament work (it gets split between the players and their crew). Team challenges are now within your crew since there are no longer teams. Be sure to check the guide or open the "war info" button for all of the details.
[b]FEATURE[/b] There are two new trophy items available as part of crew wars. The first you win by placing in the top 10% and the other you win by completing your scorecard each day of the war (personal challenges and bonus challenges).
[b]FEATURE[/b] There is now a "war raffle" that awards free casino points to random online war participants all throughout the duration of the war.
[b]FEATURE[/b] Due to the war changes, we had to also make some changes to the crew rankings. The previous update was meant to simplify the rankings, but we didn't take it far enough. The rankings are now based on a simple accumulating score total (which means it can never drop). The values that make up this score are listed in the [url=https://guide.casinorpg.com/crews/overview]game guide[/url] so you can calculate exactly what you need to move up.
[b]FEATURE[/b] The monthly crew rankings have also been simplified to work like individual monthly rankings. They now reset at the start of each month and are simply a total of the score your crew has earned within each calendar month.
[b]FEATURE[/b] The mini-map has been overhauled to use an isometric view rather than a top-down view, so it now correctly matches the view of the world. This lets you see more in the same area and also makes it easier to navigate with everything aligned.
[b]FEATURE[/b] The real estate office's map has also been overhauled to now use the regular mini-map. This means that you can now view the entire city and buy any lot from any real estate building.
[b]FEATURE[/b] The real estate office's map now also includes a button to jump to the closest available lot from your current map location.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The "wars" stat in crew info has been replaced with "war winners" which shows how many members have placed in a war.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked the battle/war scoring on solitaire, blackjack and roulette to be more in-line with the other challenges.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Various updates and improvements to the Windows Store app (only on Windows 10).
[b]UPDATE[/b] When a casino is sold, any floors with VIP status will have their lists reset.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Added the keyboard shortcut "H" to get a hint while playing solitaire.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Overhauled the new player tutorials to better introduce new players to the various aspects of the game.
[b]FIX[/b] In rare instances, away players wouldn't get removed when they should from poker tournaments.
[b]FIX[/b] Issue that could sometimes cause a table in a poker tournament to not start.
[b]FIX[/b] The contract timer now starts when you first place the contractor rather than on purchase. This also fixes an issue that could cause contracts to get stuck on your head.
[b]FIX[/b] Using the "hint" option in solitaire could sometimes cause the game to freeze.
[b]FIX[/b] The Battle tab in crew windows would sometimes go blank randomly.
[b]FIX[/b] Instant upgrades on items would sometimes show a cost of 0 and a time of null when going in/out of the editor.
[b]FIX[/b] Indoor beam lights were not showing the option to replace when they were broken.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other bug fixes and tweaks throughout the game.

notes.title: Crew Battle/War Updates
notes.content:
The last few updates to the game have been focussed on improving the crew battle/war systems to make them more fair, balanced and easy to use. Due to varying crew sizes, this was often not the case, so we've made the following changes:

[list]
[*] Crew rankings were not very transparent, so we've overhauled them and made the formula public in the wiki: https://guide.casinorpg.com/crews/overview. We've also added a new monthly ranking to the crew listings.
[*] Crew battles now have fixed-size teams. When a battle is pending, your crew leaders can select who will participate in the battle, with the team size set to the smaller crew's active player count.
[*] Crews are no longer automatically entered into wars. Once a war gets declared, your crew has 2 days to join the war. Once your crew has joined, each individual member can join and your crew only pays the entry fee for those that actually want to participate.
[*] Once the teams are set, a lottery will be run for each day of the war to balance out the teams. If the teams aren't the same size, the larger of the two teams will randomly select players to sit out for that day.
[*] Lots of other bug fixes and tweaks to improve the battle/war experience.
[/list]

We've made these changes based on all of your feedback, so please keep it coming and we'll continue to make improvements!
